resources.title: Resilient RPC Provider & Retry Starter
resources.description: A drop-in failover provider (ethers.js FallbackProvider and the equivalent viem fallback transport), an exponential-backoff wrapper for rate-limited calls, and a self-incrementing nonce tracker — the three pieces of infrastructure Lessons 2, 5, and 6 describe individually, combined into one file you can import into any backend.

resources.title: Production Event Listener Service Template
resources.description: Lesson 10's four-job listener service (connect, catch up, listen, confirm), extended to close the two gaps that lesson explicitly named as left out: a reorg-aware confirmation check using block-hash comparison, and de-duplication of events seen twice across the backfill/live boundary.

resources.title: Sign-In With Ethereum Auth Routes Starter
resources.description: A complete Express route set covering the full SIWE flow: nonce issuance, SiweMessage.verify() with domain and nonce checks, a server-side session write, a protected route, and logout — plus the wallet-account-switch invalidation pattern Lesson 23 calls out as commonly missed.

resources.title: ethers.js vs. viem Quick Reference
resources.description: Every read, write, event-listening, and confirmation operation from Chapters 1 and 2, laid out side by side in both libraries' real current syntax, so you can look up the equivalent call in either library instead of searching back through lesson guides.
